description: This file contains a shell script for managing the 'rootfs' partition in the 'bootconfig' MTD partition, specifically implementing a flip of the active root filesystem partition by modifying bytes in the MTD device.

methods.name: alfa_bootconfig_rootfs_rotate
methods.description: Rotates the active 'rootfs' partition in the specified 'bootconfig' MTD partition by toggling a byte at a given offset.
